'''Pop''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] genre. The [[Band/Legends|band]] [[Pekkie Blu and the Starboys]]
played a brand of pop known as [[Deva/Legends|Deva]] which gained them a large fanbase.<ref name="Slug1" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] the singer [[Shirley]] preformed a pop song known as "[[I'm Just His Satellite]]" in a number of exclusive performances for [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and celebrities, leading to the jaunt style of pop becoming more popular with a more respectable audience and earning Shirley the monica "The Chanteuse Of The Stars".<ref name="slug2" />
